facts.statement: Discosaurus lived during the Santonian stage of the Late Cretaceous in Alabama and Mississippi.
facts.quote: Discosaurus is an extinct genus of plesiosaur from the Santonian of Alabama and Mississippi.

facts.statement: The holotype of Discosaurus, consisting of eleven vertebrae, was discovered by Joseph Jones in Alabama and Mississippi.
facts.quote: The holotype, eleven vertebrae, was discovered by Joseph Jones in Alabama and Mississippi, and was named and described as Discosaurus vestutus by Leidy (1851).

facts.statement: Two additional specimens originally attributed to Discosaurus from New Jersey were later reclassified as Cimoliasaurus magnus.
facts.quote: Two more specimens from New Jersey were described and were later re-classified as belonging to Cimoliasaurus magnus by Leidy (1870b).

facts.statement: Discosaurus is classified within the superorder Sauropterygia and the order Plesiosauria.
Discosaurus belongs to the family Pliosauridae and the subfamily Brachaucheninae.
Discosaurus lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Leidy later argued that Discosaurus was the same animal as Elasmosaurus.
rejected.quote: Leidy (1870b) later argued that Discosaurus was the same animal as Elasmosaurus.
